Alya: (upset) What is (wrong) with you, Marinette? Couldn't you see that he was just (waiting) for you to tell him to (stay?)

scene: Hotel.
conversation:
Marinette: (
ADRIEN! STAY!: ) I've (already) lost Cat Noir, I can't lose Adrien too! (her phone dies just as she hits the call button) (
NO!: ) (she grabs a bike and helmet and starts pedaling quickly) Come back!

scene: The plane. Adrien looks out at the window somberly when he sees Uncanny Valley. Adrien hears a crash.
conversation:
Uncanny Valley: Who are you talking to?
Adrien: My kwami!
Plagg: Kwamis can't be detected by technology, which means your robobuddy can't see or hear me. (makes funny noises, waves in Uncanny's face and flies around her head)
Adrien: There's no time to lose. We have to get back on this plane before it lands!

scene: Sewers. Ladybug and Cat Noir are on either side about to detransform.
conversation:
Betterfly: In my universe ordinary people don't even know about the Miraculous, it's a secret. They all belong to The Supreme who uses them only to perpetuate his own power
Adrien: "The Supreme"?
Betterfly: The name of the evil being who rules the world where I come from
Adrien: How did you find out about the Miraculous if it's a secret?
Betterfly: Sometimes, he entrusts them to the powerful of my world, all of whom have sworn loyalty to him. I too was a part of this corrupt system in order to get something I wanted more than anything. I stole two.. but I misused them (Facepalms in shame) .. and hurt the people I loved. To redeem myself, I became Betterfly because like a moth I have no choice but to fly in the shadows in order to give people hope. Someone has to show them that we must revolt, that a better world is possible, provided that power is shared between all

scene: Sewers. Betterfly continues his speech
conversation:
Betterfly: I hold onto the one thing I have, hope. The hope for a better world, the hope that people can evolve. For a single decision that can change an entire lifetime!
Adrien: Plagg, do you think that the other holder of my Miraculous could be that other world's me?
Plagg: Well y'know, when two cheeses are made from the same milk, they can taste very different depending on how matured they are! So, I guess thats a possibility, yes

scene: Marinette's room. Shadybug knows Claw Noir's identity.
conversation:
Shadybug: (She wipes away some makeup from Adrien's face revealing some black veins from his use of the Miraculous) Ugh, makeup. Obviously, I should've guessed. (She places the Cat Miraculous on her right ring finger and turns around while Adrien looks on curiously.) Blots Off. (Detransforms back into Marinette, much to Adrien's surprise.)
Re-Verse Adrien: Ah.. (Now that Adrien knows Shadybug's identity, he remembers watching her from his car outside the bakery, not taking his eyes off of her even when his food was given to him by his bodyguard.)
Re-Verse Marinette: (seeing Adrien smiling at her, dryly) You, know me?
Re-Verse Adrien: (stutters in embarrassment, blushes and ends up just shrugging his shoulders)
Re-Verse Marinette: Nevermind. (She reads the instructions before commanding) Tikki, Plagg, reveal yourselves! (The two kwamis with a magical seal on their mouths hug each other in fear before obeying the command.)

scene: Sewers. Marinette and Adrien finish recharging
conversation:
Marinette: Tikki, Spots On! (transforms into Ladybug)
Adrien: Plagg, Claws Out! (transforms into Cat Noir)
Ladybug: We'll try to help you Betterfly

scene: Agreste private plane.
conversation:
Gabriel: The opening of this store is essential for the future of the Agreste family, Adrien. Opening it much sooner than expected is very good news. ((He puts his hand on Adrien's shoulder.)) There will be other fun times with your friends
Adrien: You're right. Besides, I'm glad I get to spend some time with you, father
Gabriel: I'm looking forward to it, too. ((Gets up.)) But before that I still have to sort out some organizational details. ((Leaves.))

scene: Shanghai. Palace Hotel’s Hotel room.
conversation:
Marinette: The Chengs have traditional songs?
Adrien: ((admiring the view of Shanghai)) The Bund district is so impressive, father! Have you ever spent time in Shanghai outside of work?
Gabriel: ((checking a clipboard)) Of course I have
Adrien: Then there must be some places you could show me. It would be great to see them together!
Gabriel: I... suppose. But before we do, I have some details to work out for tomorrow's opening night
Adrien: ((saddened)) I guess I'll just stay at the hotel and wait for you
Gabriel: ((puts hand on Adrien's shoulder)) On the contrary, take advantage of this beautiful day to walk around. I'll join you in the early afternoon. ((Adrien smiles.))

scene: Adrien walks along the Bund district with his bodyguard.
conversation:
Kang: ((shows phone)) 我可以跟你拍張照片嗎？((Speaks Mandarin): Can I take a photo with you?) ((Placide I.T. steps forward menacingly, but Adrien stops him.))
Adrien: Please, let them, I don't mind. 我很樂意這是我的榮幸 ((Speaks Mandarin): I would be happy to, it is my pleasure). ((The boys run over to him enthusiastically and start making selfies. Placide I.T. looks around and notices a stand with superhero action figures. He sneaks away and takes some. He realizes that Adrien sees him so he hides the figures. Adrien smiles.))
Lian: Hey! ((He points at the river. They continue making selfies together.))

scene: Fei walks from an alleyway to the Bund district.
conversation:
Elderly lady: 谢谢。 ((Speaks Mandarin): Thank you.) ((Fei disappears after another car passes by.))
Adrien: ((after the boys leave, his phone rings, and he picks up)) Father? You're done?.. Ah, yes, of course, I understand... Later? Yeah, sure! As you wish. See you later then. ((Hangs up, disappointed.))
Plagg: Your father won't ever change. You can depend on the consistency in a soft cheese, but in a human being? ((He groans.)) What I wouldn't give for something to eat
Adrien: ((thinks a bit and realizes)) I've got what you need, Plagg! Remember Wang Shifu, Marinette's uncle? His Thousand Delights restaurant is in this town! ((Plagg gets excited. Adrien turns to his bodyguard.)) There's a place I'd like to go. Do you mind?

scene: Thousand Delights restaurant.
conversation:
TIKKI!!!: ((She falls to the ground and starts crying.))
Adrien: Marinette is in Shanghai? What an incredible coincidence!
Wang: Or fate

scene: Thousand Delights restaurant.
conversation:
Wang: ((nervously checking the clock)) Is Marinette often late?
Adrien: Marinette? Yeah, all the time. It would actually be unusual for her to be (on time)!
Wang: ((looks at the clock again)) I'll call her anyway. ((Dials Marinette.))

scene: Alleyway.
conversation:
Adrien: She can't be very far. And I do speak Mandarin! ((To his bodyguard)) Stay here, I won't be very long
Adrien: It'll be much easier to find Marinette as Cat Noir
Plagg: And how will you explain Cat Noir's presence in Shanghai?
Adrien: I'll figure something out

scene: Alleyway.
conversation:
Adrien: I'll figure something out
Adrien: Plagg, claws out! ((Adrien transforms into Cat Noir.))
Fei: I think we're okay now. Why were you alone in Shanghai?

scene: Astro Cat lands and de-transforms. Thousand Delights restaurant.
conversation:
Fei: It's too embarrassing to translate, Marinette
Adrien: If you want, when we go back to Paris I can teach you some Mandarin
Marinette: Badly- I mean gladly! Amazesome! ((Groans.))

scene: Marinette's room at night. She is talking with Adrien through her phone.
conversation:
Marinette: I miss you so much, Adrien. It's hard, you being so far away
Adrien: I miss you too Marinette. I'm only staying in New York for a few days. I'm coming back to you soon
Marinette: Oh, I wish I was there with you. We could be dancing together like we did on our school trip, remember?
Adrien: Hold on... (Adrien types something)
Marinette: What is it?
Adrien: Click on the link and you'll see
Marinette: (She does it, and music begins to play) Ah! It's our song!
Adrien: Care to dance?
Marinette: I'm sorry, I gotta go. I promised my parents I'd read them a bedtime story tonight
Adrien: (Confused)You read bedtime stories to your-?
Marinette: Gotta go, talk soon! (Ends the call)

scene: Liberty. Marinette runs through the ship.
conversation:
Marinette: I don't know how much longer I can do this! I lied to everyone, Luka! I told them that Gabriel Agreste was a hero, but the truth is he was the supervillain! He was Monarch!
Adrien: What? My father was Monarch?! How could you hide this from me Marinette?! You lied to me!! You and I are over!!!
Marinette: NOOOOO!!!!!

scene: Hôtel de Ville, mayor's office. There is a model of city hall with a large Gabriel statue in front of it.
conversation:
Théo: Upon reconsideration, the first statue at the Place des Vosges square didn't do justice to your father's presence. This one will be erected right outside city hall, and will be more than ten meters high!
Adrien: Ten meters? That sounds pretty high, don't you think?
Théo: Of course not! Nothing's too high to illustrate the greatness of your father, Adrien! A man who was able to combine talent, presence, and courage!
Adrien: You knew my father?
Théo: Of course! I worked with him on several occasions. He was like a mentor to me. A man who defeated evil and poor taste with his nimble fingers! A man who—
Adrien: Tried to stop me from loving Marinette
Théo: Sorry?
Adrien: My father might've been a hero, but I think you're seeing him as greater than he really was

scene: Exterior of Agreste mansion. Placide I.T. opens the door for Adrien, while Marinette kisses him goodbye.
conversation:
Marinette: If you want, I can cancel my liar lesson—I MEAN—guitar lesson!
Adrien: No, no. Go ahead. Say "hi" to Luka for me
Marinette: I can't take it anymore! We have to tell Adrien the truth!

scene: Exterior of Agreste mansion. Placide I.T. opens the door for Adrien, while Marinette kisses him goodbye.
conversation:
Nathalie: And let him figure out that I was Monarch's accomplice? We (have) determined a truth. We're sticking to it. You need to grin and bare it, Marinette. It's too late to go back!
Adrien: Everything okay, Nathalie?
Nathalie: Yes. Marinette simply thought she lost the keys to her scooter

scene: Agreste mansion. Nathalie's room. Nathalie is sitting at her desk on her laptop before Adrien knocks and opens the door.
conversation:
Irupé: I'm sure you'll get there eventually
Adrien: Nathalie, I've thought about it. And I think I'd feel more comfortable if there were no statue
Nathalie: Understood. I'll take care of it, Adrien

scene: Hôtel de Ville. Cat Noir hits the building and falls to the ground.
conversation:
Ladybug: No, no, no!
Adrien: Leave her alone! (He picks up a metal pipe and starts hitting Mister Agreste's foot with it.)
Mister Agreste: Adrien!

scene: Hôtel de Ville. Cat Noir hits the building and falls to the ground.
conversation:
Chrysalis: (voice) Education first, I understand. But remember that we have a deal
Adrien: If you were such a good father then why didn't you want me to have any friends?!
Mister Agreste: (starts cracking) Huh? You don't know what you're saying, you ungrateful son

scene: Hôtel de Ville. Cat Noir hits the building and falls to the ground.
conversation:
Adrien: Why were you always traveling around the world instead of staying with mom when she was sick?!
Adrien: Why didn't you want me to meet my grandparents?
Mister Agreste: (continues to break apart while in disbelief) I... I didn't... he couldn't be like that
Adrien: Why didn't you want me to go to school like everyone else? Why didn't you want me to be in love with Marinette?!
Mister Agreste: (continuing to break apart, with Théo's voice also being able to be heard.) You're lying, you're talking nonsense!
Adrien: Why did you stop being Papa-corn and become...this! (Mister Agreste breaks apart more.) A cold...(Mister Agreste breaks even more) ...heartless... (Mister Agreste falls to his knees.) ...(statue)!

scene: Dupain-Cheng residence. Marinette's balcony. Ladybug lands on her balcony.
conversation:
Marinette: I saw what happened at your place. Are you okay?
Adrien: Everything's back in order, Marinette. I'm fine, thank you
Marinette: Are you sure? I mean, seeing your father again, it must've been
Adrien: It was just an akumatized villain. I'm going to be fine, really
Marinette: Okay. Then, good night?
Adrien: Good night, Marinette. (hangs up the call. Marinette starts to tear up.)

scene: Swimming pool.
conversation:
Bob Roth: Dove! They're doves!

Bob Roth: Nothing is gonna happen because they're doves!

conversation:

Adrien: It's my fault. I thought, I saw one of my friends from school. (Adrien and Bob Roth look in the direction where Marinette and Kagami were, but they hid somewhere else)
Bob Roth: Well, I don't see anyone, except a stupid bird that's incapable of doing what it's been asked to do and that's gonna get banned from all of Paris, if it continues to ruin the rehearsals for my commercial!

scene: Swimming pool.
conversation:
Marinette: Love is crazy! So, stop thinking too much and dive in!
Adrien: Marinette?
Mr. Ramier: Edgar!

conversation:

Adrien: Mr. Ramier

scene: Swimming pool.
conversation:
Plagg: Happy to see you again, Adrien. So still allergic to pigeons? (a feather lands on his shoulder, and he sneezes)
Adrien: Just as always, Plagg
Mr. Ramier: (disappointed) Oh no, I was the victim of Shadow Moth again, wasn't I!?

scene: Swimming pool.
conversation:
Ladybug and Rena Rouge: Pound it!
Adrien: (amazed) That girl is truly Miraculous
Kagami: You know, Marinette? That whole heart-beating, tingling, knees trembling thing? I felt all that (she taps Marinette's chest) from you. You're the one blushing and stuttering and saying silly things every time that you see Adrien. You're the one who knows his schedule by heart for the next three years. You're right, Marinette. Adrien is perfect. He's perfect - for you

conversation:

conversation:
Adrien: Awesome job, Marinette. (Marinette is blushing. Adrien begins to put on the derby hat but he starts to sneeze)
Adrien: A-achoo! (wipes his nose with his hand.) Uh-- sorry, I'm allergic to feathers. (sneezes)
Marinette: (looks surprised, then smiles.) Gesundheit!
Adrien: (sneezes again and waves) Thanks. (Alya and Marinette look at each other)
Marinette: Whoo hoo! (laughing)

Gabriel: (via video chat) Nathalie has offered to organize your new schedule. (Adrien looks at her.) You'll be continuing your music, Chinese and fencing classes, and your photo shoots
Adrien: Thank you, Nathalie! Thank you, father!
Gabriel (narrating): With her, I make a more powerful Hawk Moth than ever

scene: Île aux Cygnes. Sunny day.
conversation:
Adrien: That's what I call a day spent with you
Adrien: Hm?
Marinette: (Sits up) Something wrong?
Adrien: It's from Nathalie. Someone wants to meet with me to talk about my father's legacy
Marinette: Oh, here I am talking about how great everything is when you're dealing with so much, I'm so sorry
Adrien: (Shakes his head smiling) Don't worry about it, Marinette. I get sad when I think about my parents no longer being here obviously, but I'm also ready to move on. (Kisses Marinette's cheek) And I'm here for you. Hey! How about some ice cream to make this the perfect day even more perfect?
Marinette: Ugh

conversation:
Noé: As you can see, the Agreste brand would be joining our group. It would be the jewel at our core. Dear Adrien, your father was my role model. His demise has devastated me. (Opens a briefcase) So I can only imagine your grief, (Adrien looks down) but I know how much the fashion world weighed on you. (Noé shows Adrien a contract) If you did me the honor of selling me the brand, I would make it my utmost duty to assume responsibility for his legacy
Adrien: (Grabs the contract) Thank you. What do you think, Nathalie?
Nathalie: Hm, I think this is... (Glares at a smiling Noé) an opportunity that deserves some thought. (Gives the contract back to Adrien and continues glaring at Noé)

conversation:
Marinette: Adrien! How'd it go?

Manon: YES!

conversation:

conversation:

conversation:

Marinette: What is it this time? (The lights flicker. Something begins to dent the ceiling.) We can't stay here
Adrien: Couldn't agree more

scene: Lobby. They burst through the door and walk towards the exit. The whole room is in disorder. Lights, chairs and scaffolding are blocking the way out. Huge cracks adorn the walls and ceiling.
conversation:
Adrien: Let's get out of here!
Adrien: Ah, the exit is blocked
Marinette: (they look at each other) We’re gonna have to find another way out. (They hear a banging noise and turn around. Something is trying to get out of the elevator by smashing the door from the inside.) Fast!
Adrien: Over there! (takes her hand and they run)
Marinette: Ah!

scene: A bathroom. Marinette shuts the door behind her.
conversation:
Marinette: (takes out her national identity card and gasps) Marinette! My name is Marinette Dupain-Cheng!
Adrien: (bowing) Pleased to meet you, Marinette. (Marinette giggles. He takes his card out of his back pocket and looks at it.) Adrien Agreste
Marinette: Super nice to meet you too, Adrien. (she curtsies; he laughs) Of course! (takes her phone out of her purse) We still got our phones!
Adrien: (takes his phone out of his pocket) Brilliant!

scene: A bathroom. Marinette shuts the door behind her.
conversation:
Adrien: And we will. Until then… (They both go to lock the door. Their hands touch, they look at each other and blush.)
Adrien: What do we do—?
Marinette: Shh! (puts a finger to both their lips)

scene: A stairwell. Adrien opens the vent and looks around. He climbs out and helps Marinette, but they fall on top of each other. Shocked, they separate.
conversation:
Both: Ah! Sorry. (the kwamis fly in)
Adrien: Okay. I suggest we go upstairs
Marinette: (running up the stairs following Adrien) But there's no way up there. We're gonna get trapped again!
Adrien: We can hide out here while we signal for help
Marinette: Good idea! (they run inside. Marinette goes to a window. She looks out while pressing with her hands.) Ugh! No handle! And the glass is tinted. (turning to Adrien) They won't be able to see us
Adrien: (runs to a desk and tries the phone) Phone lines are down. (looking at his phone) If only I could remember how to unlock my phone
Marinette: Wait! (takes his phone and blows on it, revealing the passcode pattern)
Adrien: Nice work, Marinette! (unlocks his phone) Uh oh. But, who should we call?
Marinette: (unlocks her phone as well) I'm almost out of battery
Adrien: (looks at his phone) Me too. We should call our parents first. (enters his contacts and scrolls through them) Gabriel Agreste. Probably… my dad. (calls him)

scene: Adrien opens the door to an office. They peek in.
conversation:
Marinette: Sure, Mom, I will. Love you! (hangs up)
Adrien: Why didn't you ask her for help?
Marinette: (gesturing) I have both good news and bad news. The good news is: there are superheroes in the tower that will stop that supervillain. The bad news is: (we're) the superheroes! And the thing that's chasing us is the supervillain! And we're supposed to be defeating it with superpowers we (no longer have)!
Adrien: (looking worried) Eh

scene: The office. Marinette and Adrien are sitting in front of the movie poster, leaning against a column.
conversation:
Marinette: If my own mother doesn't know that I'm Ladybug, then nobody must know
Adrien: What about us? Do you think… we know?
Marinette: Hm. (looking at a photo of Adrien as her phone's background) I feel like we're more than just a superhero team
Adrien: (scrolling through images of Ladybug on his phone) Do you think we're…
Marinette: Looks like it
Adrien: Then we must have told each other everything. I couldn't hide my identity from the girl I love
Marinette: So, if we're the superheroes, then what are they? (gestures towards the kwamis by the window)
Adrien: I have no idea

scene: The office. Marinette and Adrien are sitting in front of the movie poster, leaning against a column.
conversation:
Plagg: Me, a coward? (goes to her) I am not a coward! I—I'm a free spirit, so don't come if you don't want to, but I'm out of here! (phases through the window)
Adrien: (arriving with Marinette) Did he go to get help?
Tikki: I don't think we should hold our breath

scene: The stairwell. Marinette nodds at Tikki, who flies down the stairs with the coffee cup. Marinette and Adrien run up the stairs and sit. Oblivio enters and looks at the trail of coffee leading downstairs.
conversation:
Marinette: You saved our lives! Thank you. (hugs Tikki)
Adrien: (takes Marinette's hand and leads her downstairs) Let's head back to where we were. It's the last place he'll think of looking for us
Plagg: Pfft, a coward, me? Whatever! Huh? (sees a billboard for Adrien's perfume ad) Adrien? (flies off) I may not remember my own name, but I know for a fact that I'm brave and (sees another billboard) I… am… (looks around the city and sees several more forms of the ad; screaming towards the tower) This is called psychological harassment!

scene: The office.
conversation:
Nadja: Me? What do (I) do? (gets handed a tablet and proceeds to read) Uh, don't be bemused, it's just the news. Since early this afternoon, a supervillain by the name of Oblivio has been erasing the memories of everyone he comes across. Ladybug and Cat Noir are tracking him down inside Montparnasse Tower
Adrien: Well, right now, (he's) the one tracking (us) down
Hawk Moth: (from his lair) Ladybug and Cat Noir are toying with you Oblivio. If you can't manage to find them…

scene: The office. Marinette and Adrien are holding Marinette's phone while watching news clips with Tikki from earlier in the day.
conversation:
Marinette: The drawing! There was a drawing on the elevator wall! I remember now. It was a turtle. I saw it earlier when I was looking for my mom's number. (She scrolls through her contacts) There it is! (she shows Adrien)
Adrien: You left yourself a message! So smart
Master Fu: Hello?

scene: The office. Marinette and Adrien are holding Marinette's phone while watching news clips with Tikki from earlier in the day.
conversation:
Fu: You two know your true identities, then. (they look at each other)
Adrien: We're not supposed to?
Fu: That's okay, the Miraculous Ladybugs will repair everything anyway. (Adrien shrugs)

scene: The office. Marinette and Adrien are holding Marinette's phone while watching news clips with Tikki from earlier in the day.
conversation:
Fu: Okay. Listen carefully, the red kwami's name is Tikki. (Tikki flies closer) She gives you your powers (Tikki and Marinette look at each other) Say, "Tikki, spots on," and you'll transform into Ladybug. You'll find an emergency user's guide in your bug phone. Adrien, your kwami's the black one. His name is Plagg. (Marinette looks at Adrien) Tell him, "Plagg, claws out," and you'll become Cat Noir again. The rest is in your cat phone
Adrien: But, my kwami took off
Fu: You won't be able to transform without him— (The phone turns black. Marinette squeals and they look at each other worriedly. They hear a rumbling and look up out the window at the growing bubble.)

scene: The office. They turn away from the window.
conversation:
Marinette: It's time to bring Ladybug back
Adrien: Wow, that was amazing!
Ladybug: (looking at herself) Thanks, but I don't feel like a superhero at all
Adrien: You've already proven that you are one, with or without a costume. (Ladybug smiles and shakes her head)
Ladybug: (looking at her yo-yo) Okay, there seems to be a kind of button here. (presses on the lid and it opens) User's guide? (several icons pop up around a question mark; she scrolls) "Yo-yo's features, capturing the akuma, one-time power, Lucky Charm…" wha— (her call out activates the superpower) Aaah! (she throws the yo-yo on the floor) Ee–! (She receives a teapot and catches it) Uh! What am I supposed to do with this? Make (tea)?
Adrien: Maybe it's part of a puzzle, or a riddle?
Ladybug: You're right, it must just be (one) part of the solution, but, how am I gonna find (the) solution?

Tikki: The task you were performing so well has become too much of a burden, crushing you. Your mission is now over
Adrien: But Monarch—
Plagg: Someone will succeed you. You won’t have to hide anything anymore from the ones you love. You can finally be yourself

scene: Outside Place des Vosges. Adrien is seen to be in a rush, running excitedly towards Marinette’s place. Meanwhile in her room, as Marinette sticks her photos of Adrien back on her walls, Adrien enters her trapdoor, which causes her to fumble over.
conversation:
Monarch: What a powerful negative emotion! Let’s take a closer look! (opens up a portal to see who seems to be a boxing colleague of Nora, yelling in anger) So much anger in one single person! With five Alliances to boot? (the megakuma flies to Kouki’s location) Rejoice, dear Kwamis! Five Alliances enables as many Miraculous powers to transfer at the same time! This villain promises to be exceptional! (laughs sinisterly)
Adrien: I… uh… forgot to give you your homework. (proceeds to enter her room)
Marinette: (while trying hard to cover all her photos of Adrien on her wall) Uh… you know, earlier, I… I didn’t mean what I said. I was feeling down. I told you horrible things because I just wanted to be alone
Adrien: So, when you said that you used to love me, that wasn’t true?
Marinette: No, no, of course I lo— I love… I love… (aggressively) I love… I— GAH!
Adrien: Are you okay?
Marinette: No, no, wait, wait! I can do this. I… (shivers) I lo… I… GAH! I can’t do this! What is wrong with me??
Adrien: You don’t have to tell me anything if you can’t. Hold on, I have an idea. (brings down his bag) I’m gonna ask you some questions. Raise your right hand for “yes”, (raises his right hand) and your left hand for “no”. (raises his left hand)

scene: Outside Place des Vosges. Adrien is seen to be in a rush, running excitedly towards Marinette’s place. Meanwhile in her room, as Marinette sticks her photos of Adrien back on her walls, Adrien enters her trapdoor, which causes her to fumble over.
conversation:
Adrien: Did you ever love me?
Adrien: You also said that you no longer love me. If that wasn’t true, does that mean that… you still love me?
Marinette: No, wait! (puts down her left hand and titters nervously) I always confuse my left and right. (chuckles)
Adrien: If you need more time… (Marinette raises her right hand abruptly) more time… with me? (Marinette raises her right hand once again and puts it down)
Marinette: Thanks for bringing my homework. (walks closer towards Adrien)
Adrien: I’m really glad that I did

scene: Interior, the Dupain-Cheng’s Residence, in Marinette’s room. Adrien and Marinette stare at one another, lovesick. The two avert their eyes on each other shyly shortly after.
conversation:
Alya: (fixes her glasses) Then, if it means my BFF can be happy, I accept!
Adrien: (while rubbing the back of his neck) Right, so… I guess I’ll go?
Marinette: Oh! Sure— AH!

scene: At the Dupain-Cheng’s Residence, on Marinette’s balcony. As the Miraculous Ladybugs continue to put the city back in place, Marinette is still seen holding onto Adrien’s arm. Upon realizing it, she lets go of his arm immediately.
conversation:
Marinette: Oh! (titters nervously) Sorry
Adrien: (rubs the back of his neck) That’s okay. (leans on the rail) I don’t know what happened to the other Ladybug and Cat Noir, but these two heroes seem to be amazing, don’t you think?
Marinette: So, it’s safe now?
Adrien: Yeah. The coast is clear
Marinette: (bitterly) Oh. That means… you can head home
Adrien: Yeah. But I’ll see you tomorrow at school?
Marinette: Yes

scene: Adrien's room. Adrien and Plagg watch the broadcast, where Tom and Jagged are singing together to the tune of "Smoke on the Water".
conversation:
Plagg: (gulping a piece of Camembert) Oh, come on! Are you going to finally put cheese on that bread or what? Since when do you have any interest in (this) show?
Adrien: The show's being shot at Marinette's
Tom and Jagged: ♫ This is the baker's rock 'n' roll! ♫

scene: Adrien's room. Adrien and Plagg have seen the mayhem on TV.
conversation:
Adrien: You're just a floating stomach!
Adrien: Plagg, claws out! (Adrien transforms into Cat Noir.)
Troublemaker: Here comes trouble again, Jagged! (starts toward Jagged)

scene: In front of Collège Françoise Dupont, Marinette waves to Alya, Nino, and Adrien before getting on Luka's bike
conversation:
Alya: Bye!
Adrien: (receives message from Kagami) Bye guys! (hurries to car waiting for him)
Marinette: (sees an akuma) Luka, stop! (gets off bike, handing him her helmet) Sorry, I just remembered that I promised I would help a friend! I'll call you later! (disappears into the subway entrance, reappears on the other side as Ladybug)

scene: Agreste mansion. Front Hall. The doorbell rings, Nathalie, hunched over, in her pajamas and with her hair in disarray, slowly walks toward the door.
conversation:
Marinette: (Laughs) No no no. It's not the same thing at all. Yesterday we had croissants, the day before was Pain Au Chocolat, but today (Puts the giant bag full of Chouquettes on the dining room table), I brought Chouquettes!
Adrien: (Walks over to Marinette) Not to mention the orange juice is already pressed,(Marinette seeing him squeals and both hug each other) and the eggs are already scrambled and the-!
Nathalie: (Tiredly) And the alarm clock hasn't gone off yet

scene: Agreste mansion. Front Hall. The doorbell rings, Nathalie, hunched over, in her pajamas and with her hair in disarray, slowly walks toward the door.
conversation:
Johnny: Magnifique! We'll pick you up at 6:00 p.m. (Closes the video call)
Adrien: Do you really like horror movies now?
Marinette: (Voice break) Love 'em! Don't you?

scene: School Bathroom. Alya, Tikki and Trixx are inside with Marinette.
conversation:
Alya: And what did he say?
Adrien: (Flashback): I don't know Marinette. I've never even watched a horror movie, but it sounds like fun. I'm curious to find out with you
Marinette: And now, I'm done for!

scene: Collège Françoise Dupont. Cafeteria
conversation:
Nelson: Of course not, I really mean it. What do you say?
Adrien: First you should apologize
Aglaé: And repay Prem for what you've done!

scene: Collège Françoise Dupont library. Marinette sees Adrien sitting at a table alone. Marinette hides behind a nearby bookshelf.
conversation:
Lila: Ladybug!
Adrien: (sighing) She's amazing
Lila: A girl doesn't need to wear a costume to be amazing, you know. (scoots her seat closer to Adrien)
Adrien: Uh, I don't know—I mean, I—
Lila: So you've got a little soft spot for the bug, huh?
Adrien: Me? Oh, no! Not at all!
Lila: You know I actually happen to be very close friends with Ladybug
Adrien: Really?!
Lila: We can chat about it if you want. Not here though. Why don't we meet at the park after school and I'll tell you everything
Adrien: (gets an alert from his phone) I gotta go! I've got a lesson in 58 seconds. (Lila causes Adrien to drop his bag on the floor)
Lila: So, the park? (pushes the superhero book on the floor away from Adrien's bag with her foot)
Adrien: Uh sure! (runs out)
Lila: (picks up the book) A vixen superheroine? Hmm, interesting... (leaves the library)

scene: The Place des Vosges. Marinette hides behind a tree. Lila is sitting on a bench.
conversation:
Marinette: Tikki! (runs after her hiding behind the trash canister)
Adrien: So you do know Ladybug, for real?
Tikki: (carrying the book) This is the book Marinette! (Marinette grabs the book)

scene: Paris. A meteor appears in the sky, hurtling down toward the city. Adrien is just getting home, and upon seeing the meteor, runs to his room.
conversation:
Lila: It would be my pleasure, Hawk Moth. (transforms into Volpina and uses her new power to change the poster of Ladybug into one of Volpina and Adrien)
Adrien: Plagg, claws out! (Adrien transforms into Cat Noir.)
Ladybug: Code Red!

scene: Adrien's room. Cat Noir arrives and detransforms.
conversation:
Volpina: See what I mean! She's jealous of me, of you, of us, but this time you aren't going to ruin our date Ladybug
Adrien: Mm excuse me, but it wasn't really quite a date, per say. (Volpina turns to him angrily) I mean- what I meant was it could've become one right? No need to get bent out of shape!
Ladybug: (to Adrien) Excuse us, but I need to have a chat with super liar. (to Volpina) You!) Stop thinking your illusions are reality!

scene: Adrien's room. Adrien is looking through his bag.
conversation:
Tikki: The Great Guardian. And I think the time has come for you to finally meet him
Adrien: Did you take my father's book, Plagg?
Plagg: (mouth stuffed with cheese) Of course not!
Adrien: If he finds out it's missing, I'll have something worse than Hawk Moth to deal with

scene: Agreste mansion, Émilie and Gabriel's bedroom. Flashback from the past.
conversation:
Adrien: So this mean you have a daddy and a mommy too?
Émilie: Yes and they're your grandpa and grandma
Adrien: Where are they?
Émilie: Far away
Adrien: Where is far away? Can we go there?
Émilie: You know, Adrien, being a daddy or a mommy means loving your children more than anything in the world, and there are things that my daddy and my mommy… love more than me. (Adrien looks sad.) Things that sometimes make them… (Wipes tears.) not so good. That's why we never see them
Adrien: Does that mean that daddy doesn't love me?
Émilie: Why would you say that?
Adrien: Because we never see daddy. He's never here
Émilie: (Puts her hand on her son's chin.) No, no, it's just that daddy travels a lot. He goes around the world with Nathalie looking for important things. One day, they'll find them and I'll get better, then we'll all stay home. Together

scene: Dupain-Cheng residence, Marinette's room; Agreste mansion, kitchen.
conversation:
Marinette: Then… okay! (Takes out her phone and calls Adrien. Runs off upstairs to her bedroom.)
Adrien: (Picks up.) Ah, Marinette
Marinette: Hello, Adrien. (Marinette's entire family peeks inside through the door. The girl gestures at them to hide.) Are you free for lunch on Sunday?
Adrien: I… no, I… already have something planned
Marinette: Oh… is it something… important?
Adrien: I'm meeting my grandparents
Marinette: Woah, that's amazing! (Adrien doesn't answer. He looks sad.) What?
Adrien: I'm not sure. I don't know them. I never even met them before
Marinette: Seriously?
Adrien: My mom's parents… she didn't want us to see them
Marinette: Huh? But… why not?
Adrien: She said they were mean. As for my father, he never even told me about his parents
Marinette: Wow…
Adrien: And now, all of a sudden they're determined to see me. I don't know what to do. You know how much I'd love to spend Sunday with you
Marinette: Me too. But, you know what? Since you can't come to my place, (Stands up.) I'll come to yours! I'm an expert at grandparents. I'm sure they're not that bad. And if they really are mean, then I'll protect you! Because you're family– well, not yet– uh, I mean, almost? (Facepalms.) What do you say?
Adrien: If that's possible, then… I think I'd like you to be there with me, yes
Marinette: Of course it's possible! You'll see, give me Nathalie

scene: Agreste mansion, dining room.
conversation:
Marinette: Hence, the uniform. (Spins around.)
Adrien: (whispers to his girlfriend) The shellfish cracker goes to the right of the fish fork
Marinette: (Swaps the utensils' placement.) Oops. (Giggles awkwardly.)

scene: Agreste mansion, dining room.
conversation:
Nathalie: I'm counting on the two of you to let me know how it went
Adrien: What do you mean? You– you're not having lunch with us?
Nathalie: I'm (not) part of the family

scene: Agreste mansion, entrance hall.
conversation:
Emil: You're (not) having us. May I remind you this estate used to be our pied-à-terre in Paris before we allowed our daughter and her dressmaker husband to live here? (Looks over at Adrien.) Now, at least they produced a half-decent-looking child
Adrien: Grandfather. (Nods.) Grandmother. (Nods.)
Emil: "Lord Graham", please

scene: Agreste mansion, dining room.
conversation:
Adrien: Thank you! (Runs into the kitchen)
Adrien: (Runs in) (whispers) Plagg? Plagg! (Looks under the table. The door opens, surprising Adrien, making him accidentally slam his head into the table)
Marinette: Adrien?
Adrien: Marinette!
Marinette: (Runs up to him) I know this must be hard, but everything's gonna be okay. (Grabs his hands, then hugs him)
Adrien: You're right, it'll be okay. (Pats her on the back)

scene: Agreste mansion, dining room.
conversation:
Marinette: (whispers to Adrien) Let me handle this
Adrien: (whispers) Marinette, no!
Emil: Oh, Milly, (Slams his hands down on the table) are you actually going to taste this horror?!

scene: Agreste mansion, dining room.
conversation:
Emil: Milly, be a dear and suffer in silence as you're used to doing so well. (Milly's mood worsens) As I was saying, it's time Adrien and the twin ring came back to– (Notices the ring isn't where Adrien set it down anymore. Marinette gasps in shock upon seeing it herself) Adrien, where is the twin ring?!
Adrien: I… I gave it to you, Lord Graham
Emil: (Looks around the table for the family heirloom. He sets his eyes on Johnny, sitting in front of him) You…

scene: Agreste mansion, entrance hall.
conversation:
Emil: Milly, get back in this instant! MILLY! (Tries to open the door) MILLY! MILLY!
Adrien: (Tries to calm his Kwami down) Plagg, get a hold of yourself!
Plagg: I can't! Maroilles' too delicious!

scene: Agreste mansion, entrance hall.
conversation:
Ringmaster: On the contrary, (stay), since this fight is for you! (Throws her bowtie at Adrien. It encloses him inside a giant, golden trophy)
Adrien: Marinette, get somewhere safe!
Marinette: Nathalie, take care of Gabrielle! I'll go get help!

scene: Ringmaster's boxing ring.
conversation:
Plagg: Just transform and use your power to destroy the whole thing!
Adrien: But then everyone would know that I'm Cat Noir
Plagg: In that case, relax and take this chance to enjoy a ballotine with me. (Pulls out one he stored from the meal and eats it)

scene: Agreste mansion, entrance hall.
conversation:
Milly: Bye-bye, Ladybug!
Adrien: Where is Marinette? (Runs into the kitchen.) Marinette? (Checks his dad's office) Marinette!
Ladybug: (Sneaks in through the window) Spots off! (Detransforms. Marinette hides behind a couch)
Adrien: (Enters and searches) Marinette? Marinette!

scene: Agreste mansion, dining room.
conversation:
Milly: (Slips the twin rings off her finger) This ring belongs to Adrien. (Places it on the table) (He) should decide his own future
Adrien: (Puts the rings back on) Thank you. But… I don't know what I want
Marinette: (Walks over to the door. Opens it and drags Nathalie inside) I'm still just a teenager, Nathalie, and I'm only Adrien's girlfriend (Gabrielle, Johnny and Milly smile at her), and I (can't) decide for him or stop his grandparents from fighting for his custody, but (you) are an adult and more importantly, (you're) the one who's been taking care of him since his parents disappeared. If there's one thing I know for sure, it's that to Adrien, you're like a mother now

scene: Agreste mansion, dining room.
conversation:
Adrien: (Hugs Nathalie) My life is here in Paris, with Marinette, my friends and (you)
Adrien: (to his grandparents) I'll come visit you for the holidays. We'll get to know each other better, if you'd like that of course
Gabrielle: Of course, we'd love that!

scene: Exterior, Île aux Cygnes. Luka continues to play the violin while Marinette and Adrien watch him play.
conversation:
Toy Vendor: (as Santa Claus) Merry Christmas, everyone! (continues to drop gift boxes)
Adrien: This is a nightmare, right?
Robo Tech Ultimate Destructor: I will turn you into mush!

conversation:
Wishmaker: Live your childhood dream!
Adrien: When I was a kid, I always wanted to be what my parents wanted me to be!
Shadow Moth: (gasps in shock after discovering Adrien is Cat Noir) My son?!

conversation:
Luka: Uh- It was nothing, Marinette! You know you can always count on me!
Adrien: (runs to join Luka and Marinette) You guys are okay!
Luka: We're all okay, thanks to Ladybug and Cat Noir
Adrien: I may not remember my childhood dreams, but that's okay! It's time to focus on the future and find my inner music, like Luka said! Plagg? What are you doing?

conversation:
Max: When it comes to phobias or fears seeing a specialist is most recommended. I myself see a psychiatrist because I'm on the autism spectrum

Max: It means I see things in a different way than you do

conversation:

Marinette: Your father? Why? You can talk to me about him, right?
Adrien: Yes, of course, you're right

conversation:
Plagg: Don't tell me, you want to play Cat Noir and rescue your girlfriend
Adrien: Precisely! Plagg, claws out! (transforms into Cat Noir.)
Wreckless Driver: Hm, quite significant. You do have a phobia of insects, and more specifically these awful butterflies. I'll fix it for you

conversation:

conversation:

Adrien: (recording) Thanks for the surprise, Marinette. I love you too
Tikki: You really are the superhero of surprises
Adrien: Marinette is so wonderful. She always does amazingly creative things for me like this surprise while... the only thing I can do is send her a voice message

conversation:

Adrien: No, Plagg, I chose knitting because Marinette is passionate about fashion design, and I'm sure she won't be expecting this surprise
Marinette: Mm... Oh, it's a towel! A hand towel?

Marinette: Oh, right, of course it's a t-shirt! These bigger holes are for arms. This is so surprising, Adrien, that's so nice of you. Thank you

conversation:
Dog: Woof woof!

Plagg: Or just another beef rib

conversation:

Adrien: You thought that...?

conversation:

Adrien: Not bad, huh?
Kagami: What about (my) ring!?
Adrien: Félix, open your hand.(Félix does as asked and Kagami's ring appears in his palm) TA-DA!

Adrien: No! No! Ms. Tsurugi, you're mistaken! Kagami is just a friend, I'm in love with Marinette!
Yaksi Gozen: I'm not taking any risks believing in Agreste!

conversation:

Adrien: Oh!
Plagg: See, Sugarcube? A good meal is always a success!

conversation:
